labels: The wide culottes flare like a skirt at rest, but the separated trouser legs and two inner leg seams are visible as the wearer steps apart.; 넓은 퀼로트는 가만히 있을 때 치마처럼 퍼지지만 착용자가 두 발을 벌리자 갈라진 바지통과 두 안쪽 다리선이 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The wide culottes flare like a skirt at rest, but the separated trouser legs and two inner leg seams are visible as the wearer steps apart.
aliases: 퀼로트의 갈라진 넓은 통
